Bicourt (2nd) Hudson(5th) Clarke (6th) Chandler (8th) and Freeman (9th) were involved in a close tussle in the boys' match, but were beaten 25/30 by Mitcham.

Freeman may have walked a blinder but for me Len's was the finest performance of all. Although Len's contribution to Belgrave is clear in the record book, he has winning team medals for all the national championships, his sportsmanship and humour must also feature highly.
